questions.prompt: Is the reason we entered this position (`entry.sig`, `entry.why`) still valid? Goal: we hold an open position (`pos`). Decide whether to keep holding or close it now. You can only hold or close the whole position; the stop is never widened and size is never added. A wrong close costs fees and the remaining move; a wrong hold can cost up to the stop. Inputs: `pnl_bps`, `age_min`, distance to stop and take-profit in bps, recent returns, taker flow (`buy`, `cvd30_k`), liquidations, funding, the book, and whether today's strategist card still supports the trade (`card`). New inputs: `pos.entry_px`; `pos.peak_bps` = best unrealized PnL so far, `pos.giveback_bps` = how much of that peak is gone; `pos.pnl_r`/`pos.peak_r` = the same in units of the initial stop distance; `pos.be_bps` = PnL after round-trip fees; `pos.path_bps` = unrealized PnL at earlier checks, oldest first; `entry` = why we entered (signal type, trigger text, entry-time genuine/take probabilities); `trail` = trailing stop: on, active, and bps from price to the trailing stop; `kronos.agree` = 1 if the forecast model's averaged path ends in the position's direction, else 0; `kronos.rank` = where this coin's forecast return ranks among all coins forecast now (top/mid/bottom); `against` (only on urgent checks) = a rule trigger just fired in the OPPOSITE direction of our position: its type, side, volume multiple, taker buy share, whether it is a strong type, seconds ago.
How likely is a sharp move against the position in the next few minutes?

Should we keep holding the whole position or close all of it now? If the position is in profit after fees (`pos.be_bps` > 0), weigh how much of the peak profit (`pos.peak_bps`, `pos.giveback_bps`) has already been given back and whether the trailing stop (`trail`) already protects it. A position that is losing but still inside its stop is not by itself a reason to close: the stop already limits that loss.
